source.notes: The 15 points are adapted from the adzpm/pubg-map community dataset. They have not been verified in-game for this project; completeness and current validity are unverified. Original x/y values are source-image pixels; the upstream info.json records an 8192 x 8192 px image. Values here are normalized as x/8192 and y/8192, with a top-left origin, x increasing rightward and y increasing downward. size_m:8000 is an approximate metre scale based on Erangel's nominal 8 x 8 km map size; 8192 image pixels do not mean 8192 metres. Distances are estimated straight-line values. Stable ids and English display names were added. No source map image is included. The full MIT license is in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md. Source recorded: 2026-10-21. Seven separate historical bunker entrance observations from PUBG Resource are added as tunnel_entrance: four Shelter entrances and three northern bunker entrances. The offshore Starting Island entrance is excluded from gameplay targets. They are not additional key-locked secret rooms, and current access/doorway precision are unverified. The entrance source uses a separate 1000-unit plane, normalized x/1000,y/1000, with source image alignment checked against the bundled reference. Exact factual records, source fingerprints, convention and uncertainty are retained in data-sources/erangel-bunker-entrances.json. No source code, icons, text or map tiles are redistributed; the MIT license covers these LootLizard annotations, not the original site assets. Reviewed 2026-10-22.
